description: We're a student organisation of high schoolers from two Bratislava schools. Outside this hackathon, we develop our own CanSat and solid-fuel rocket. These projects build practical skills and connect us with like-minded students and aerospace professionals who share their knowledge. Our dream is to become Slovakia's first organisation dedicated to inspiring students to explore aerospace. This is our first hackathon, and we're excited to take on a new challenge and build something meaningful.
